scripts.dev: bun run prepare:sdk && bun ./scripts/run-with-host-socket.mjs nsh run App.tsx
scripts.dev:macos: bun run prepare:sdk && bun ./scripts/run-with-host-socket.mjs nsh run App.tsx --target macos
scripts.dev:web: bun run prepare:sdk && nsh run App.tsx --target web
scripts.dev:ios: bun run prepare:sdk && nsh run App.tsx --target ios
scripts.dev:android: bun run prepare:sdk && nsh run App.tsx --target android
scripts.dev:server: bun run prepare:sdk && nsh dev App.tsx --server-only
scripts.build: bun run prepare:sdk && nsh build App.tsx --release
scripts.package:macos: bun run prepare:sdk && nsh package --target macos
scripts.package:web: bun run prepare:sdk && nsh package --target web
